Lake Erie Walleye
Crusted · Lemon Butter · Bay Seasoned Red Skins
The Story

Crusted walleye over lemon butter, with sautéed broccolini, bay-seasoned red skin potatoes, and a charred lemon.

Lake Erie walleye is the defining catch of the Great Lakes. Mild, flaky, sweet white flesh that holds up to a crust and lets the lemon butter shine.

The crust adds texture. The lemon butter cuts richness. Broccolini and red skins finish the plate.

The Lake
Lake Erie holds the largest walleye population of any of the Great Lakes. Local, seasonal, and the signature fish of the menu since day one.
